description: What the exclusion-match call returns (A22). Code validates the indexes and builds the citations.

matched.description: 0-based indexes from the numbered exclusion list, most specific first, at most 3; empty for no_match
matched.title: Matched

reason.description: One short English sentence naming the exclusion by its wording and why it applies; empty string for no_match
reason.title: Reason

verdict.description: match = clearly inside an exclusion; possible = might apply, depends on facts not given; no_match = no listed exclusion applies (this does NOT mean covered)
verdict.title: Verdict
